transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

...I suppose I'm here because of work. I do computer support. 

Just... for well over a year now, I’ve been trying to get someone to actually take this seriously. The new ticket rotation they set up, and the security audits... it's obvious they're being used to build a paper trail against me. Management keeps showing me the logs, telling me it’s just standard policy, but... 

Yeah. That's why I'm here.
Even when management shows you the logs and says this is standard policy, are you still certain they’re building a case against you?

...Yes. I mean, I know what they tell me. But... like I just said, it's been over a year of this. I've been trying to get someone to actually look at what's happening. 

They can show me whatever logs they want and call it policy, but... I know what those audits are really for. They're building a paper trail.
Do you believe this is definitely happening, or is there any chance you might be mistaken?

...I'm not mistaken. 

I wouldn't have spent well over a year trying to get someone to listen to me if I wasn't sure. I've been doing this job a long time. I know how the systems work, and... I know what they're doing. I'm not mistaken.
Have you been hearing voices when no one is there?
...No. I don't hear voices. Just the people in the office.
Has anything happened that makes you think management can monitor or control your thoughts?
...No. They just monitor my work. Not my thoughts.
Do you ever feel that thoughts are being put into your mind by someone or something else?
...No. I don't know what you mean by that. My thoughts are my own.
Outside of this problem at work, do you generally find it hard to trust other people?
...No. Not really. I just... I keep to myself mostly. I don't have a problem trusting people outside of work.
Has anything happened at work that would be impossible in real life, or is your concern only that management is trying to build a case against you through normal workplace procedures?
...No. Nothing impossible. It's just... standard procedures. They're just using the system to build a case against me. That's it.
Did this belief about management start very suddenly?
...Not suddenly, no. It just... it kind of built up over time. Just noticing little things here and there.
Over this past year, have you found yourself becoming emotionally flat or losing interest in things you usually care about?
...No. I don't think so. I still... do the things I usually do. Nothing has really changed with that.
Apart from your concerns about management at work, do you have any other beliefs that other people say are strange or hard to believe?
...No. Just work. I don't... I don't really talk to people about other things. Just trying to do my job.
During this past year, have there been times when other people told you your speech or behavior seemed very confused or disorganized?
...No. Nobody has said anything like that to me. I just go to work, do my job, and go home. I don't think I'm confused.
During the time this has been going on, have you had a period of feeling depressed most of the day nearly every day?
...No. I wouldn't say that. I mean, work is stressful with everything going on, but... I'm not depressed. Just tired sometimes.
Because of this situation with management, has your ability to do your job gotten worse?

...I wouldn't say worse, exactly. Just... different. I've had to be more careful. I don't really take on the bigger network projects anymore. And I have to spend a lot of time writing out detailed notes in my support tickets, just to cover myself. It takes longer, sure. And I guess the team meetings are a bit... tense. People don't always want to wait for me to do things my way, but I have to.
Have other people told you that you seem emotionally flat or show less expression than you used to?
...No. I haven't heard anything like that from anyone. I just... I keep my head down and do my work. So, no.
